The protocol was tested by comparing it to current WHO mapping methodologies in one district each in Mali and Senegal. The ITM methodology reached the same conclusions as the WHO methodologies for trachoma, lymphatic filariasis, and soil-transmitted helminths. However, the ITM methodology resulted in more targeted intervention recommendations for schistosomiasis. The ITM protocol was feasible and resulted in a 31% overall cost saving in Mali and a 19% overall cost saving in Senegal compared to standard WHO methodologies.
